parameters.name: longitude

parameters.name: model

description: Read Windy's weather in a workflow. Get a point forecast for any coordinates from 21 models (temperature, wind and gusts, rain and snow, cloud, humidity and pressure), a marine forecast with waves, swell and ocean currents, and an air quality forecast with the US AQI, pollutants and European pollen. Also search Windy's worldwide webcam collection by place or category and get each camera's still image, live stream and timelapse links.
